question: Shared: prediction of conversion from MCI to Alzheimer's disease among ADNI MCI patients, with structural MRI as the shared channel. P-168's headline model is multimodal (neuropsychological tests + FreeSurfer volumes + demographics, five visits); the paper the record means for P-174 is Bae et al. 2021 (single baseline raw 3D T1 MRI, 3D-CNN). P-174 itself is a stub duplicate and its mapped PDF is P-173's MEG paper; Bae et al. was read from the repository copy (held as the P-37 text). The horizons differ (2 vs 3 years), which condition 1 allows.

figures.P-168: Longitudinal multimodal LSTM 0.93 +/- 0.06 (fold SD), n=347 (77/270): Hanley-McNeil SE 0.0206 -> 0.890-0.970. MRI-only LSTM 0.86: SE 0.0279 -> 0.805-0.915. MRI-only random forest (single time point) 0.85: SE 0.0287 -> 0.794-0.906. No intervals printed.
figures.P-174 (Bae et al. 2021): Independent test set of 68 scans: accuracy 82.4%, AUC 0.827. The test set holds 37 converters (0-3 years), hence 31 non-converters. No interval printed. Hanley-McNeil: Q1=0.827/1.173=0.705, Q2=2(0.827^2)/1.827=0.749, SE=sqrt[(0.143+36(0.705-0.684)+30(0.749-0.684))/(37*31)] = 0.0498 -> 0.729-0.925.

matched_figure_check: P-168 reports MRI-only models, the channel Bae et al. use. The single-timepoint MRI random forest, 0.85 (0.794-0.906), and Bae's 0.827 (0.729-0.925) each lie inside the other's interval; the MRI-only LSTM, 0.86 (0.805-0.915), also agrees. The matched figures agree, so the pair fails condition 3. The headline 0.93 lies just outside Bae's interval (upper bound 0.925), but P-168's own models show that the excess over MRI alone comes from the neuropsychological input Bae does not use.
performance_validity: Exclusion does not apply: no figure reaches 0.97.
reason: The studies share a clinical question (MCI-to-AD conversion in ADNI) and the MRI channel. On the matched MRI-only input, P-168's AUCs (0.85, 0.86) agree with Bae et al.'s 0.827 within uncertainty, so the papers' own data dissolve the headline 0.93-vs-0.827 gap. The record also attributes Bae's figure to P-174, a stub duplicate whose mapped PDF is another paper; the figure itself is printed correctly in Bae et al.
